paragraphs.text: Join me and my co-host Jerusalem Demsas for the very first live edition of our podcast!
We’ll be on stage Wednesday, December 9, at Miracle Theatre in Washington, D.C. — and we’re offering a discount on tickets for Slow Boring subscribers.
Below, paid subscribers can find a code for ~40% off. If you’re not a paid subscriber, upgrade today for access to the code (plus you’ll get to read all the articles!).

If you’re not a regular listener to the pod and would like to check out the podcast before the live show, you can find us on YouTube or subscribe to hear more: Apple Podcasts | Spotify | YouTube | Overcast | Pocket Casts
